feature_review.ISA_support: Runtime advertises AES/PMULL/SHA1/SHA2/CRC32/ASIMD/FP; target-cpu is a CPU model plus default target features, not scheduling-only. No LSE/SVE features were enabled by the observed target cfg.
feature_review.pmuv3_limit: LLVM target capability does not establish Linux perf_event availability or permission. Earlier router PMU inventory had no event source/perf; no user PMU instructions or new perf helper are introduced.
feature_review.project_cfg_audit: dnsmasq/ubus source has no inline asm and no aes/crc/sha2/pmuv3 conditional branch; existing crt-static and target_arch branches retain their values.
feature_review.probe_limit: Local rustc is the same 1.98.1 commit/LLVM22.1.8 as F build, on Darwin host. The two tiny LLVM-IR probes only validate option identity; they are neither product builds nor speed measurements.

lto_review.current: Already fat LTO with one codegen unit. Do not describe this variant as enabling LTO.
lto_review.thin: Not changed. ThinLTO is a different optimization/link tradeoff, not an established IPC improvement for this artifact. Any future thin comparison must be a separate single-variable F build with fat/generic control; do not combine it with target-cpu or product changes.
